label: AgMsv_2.132
cite_parts:
nūnaṃ jhaṭiti saṃpluṣṭasthūlarūpatayā haṭhāt /
yānti bodhamahājvālāprakāśaikyaṃ svarūpataḥ /
sa eṣa paramo homo bhairavīyakrame mataḥ // [AgMsv_2.132]
quick_english: Surely, when their gross form is suddenly burned away, things forcibly attain unity with the great blazing light of awareness by their very nature; this is regarded as the supreme offering in the Bhairava tradition.

tokens.grounds: instrumental of manner; compound describing dissolution of gross form
accusative goal; compound expressing identity with blazing awareness

label: AgMsv_2.133
cite_parts:
nijabodhajaṭharahutabhuji bhāvāḥ samyagsamarpitā yuktyā /
jahati bhedavibhāgaṃ nijaśaktyā taṃ samindhate yasmāt // [AgMsv_2.133]
quick_english: When entities are properly offered by method into the fire within one's own awareness, they abandon the division of difference and, by their own power, kindle that very fire.

tokens.grounds: locative compound; awareness as sacrificial fire
object, refers to the fire of awareness

label: AgMsv_2.134
cite_parts:
yad eva svecchayā sṛṣṭisvābhāvyavaśataḥ puraḥ /
nirmimīte 'kṣaviṣayaṃ taddhyānāyāvakalpate // [AgMsv_2.134]
quick_english: Whatever sense-object consciousness creates before itself by its own will and by the force of its creative nature becomes fit for meditation on that very object.

tokens.grounds: object created; elided initial vowel in sandhi
predicate verb; compound with infinitive-like dative sense

label: AgMsv_2.135
cite_parts:
nirākāre hi ciddhāmni viśvākṛtimaye sati /
phalārthināṃ kācid eva dhyeyatvenākṛtiḥ sthitā // [AgMsv_2.135]
quick_english: For although the abode of consciousness is formless and yet made of all forms, for those who seek results some particular form is established as the object of meditation.

tokens.grounds: fused compound with instrumental sense of 'as'; subject of clause

label: AgMsv_2.136
cite_parts:
yathā hy abhedasaṃpūrṇe bhāve 'py udakam āharan /
anyākṛtyapahānena ghaṭam arthayate rasāt // [AgMsv_2.136]
quick_english: Just as, even within a nondual and full reality, someone fetching water eagerly seeks a pot by setting aside other forms, so too a particular form may be chosen.

tokens.grounds: explanatory particle, sandhi form of hi
concessive particle, sandhi form of api

label: AgMsv_2.137
cite_parts:
tathaiva parameśānaniyatipravijṛmbhaṇāt /
kācid evākṛtiḥ kāṃcit sūte phalavikalpanam // [AgMsv_2.137]
quick_english: In the same way, through the unfolding of the supreme Lord's self-restriction, some particular form gives rise to some particular conception of a result.

label: AgMsv_2.138
cite_parts:
yas tu saṃpūrṇacidvṛttir na phalaṃ nāma vāñchati /
tasya viśvākṛti dhyānaṃ sarvadaiva vijṛmbhate // [AgMsv_2.138]
quick_english: But for one whose activity is the fullness of consciousness and who desires no result at all, meditation in the form of the whole universe unfolds at all times.

tokens.grounds: relative subject, sandhi form of yaḥ

label: AgMsv_2.139
cite_parts:
kulayogina udriktabhairavīyarasāsavāt /
ghūrṇamānasya yaḥ kaścit ko 'py udeti yathā tathā // [AgMsv_2.139]
quick_english: For the Kula yogin reeling from the intoxicant of the surging Bhairava essence, whatever arises, in whatever way it arises, simply arises.

tokens.grounds: genitive of subject, sandhi form of kulayoginaḥ
emphatic particle, sandhi form of api

label: AgMsv_2.140
cite_parts:
śarīragaḥ samāveśo modanadrāvaṇātmakaḥ /
sā svīkṛtajaganmudrā mudrā nairuttare mate // [AgMsv_2.140]
quick_english: The bodily absorption whose nature is delight and melting is, in the unsurpassed teaching, the seal that has taken the whole world as its seal.

label: AgMsv_2.141
cite_parts:
eṣa yogavidhiḥ ko 'pi kasyāpi hṛdi vartate /
yasya prasīdec ciccakraṃ drāg apaścimajanmanaḥ // [AgMsv_2.141]
quick_english: This rare method of yoga abides in the heart of someone whose wheel of consciousness becomes clear, quickly, as in the case of one who is in his final birth.

tokens.grounds: emphatic particle, sandhi form of api

label: AgMsv_2.142
cite_parts:
lokenālokyamāno 'pi dehabandhavidhau sthitaḥ /
abhyeti yoge rūḍhe na kṣaṇāt kām api saṃvidam // [AgMsv_2.142]
quick_english: Even while being seen by people and remaining in the condition of bodily bondage, when yoga has matured he attains in an instant an incomparable awareness.

tokens.grounds: present passive participle with instrumental agent
concessive particle, sandhi form of api

label: AgMsv_2.143
cite_parts:
atraiva tv asmatpūrvācāryāṇāṃ dhiṣaṇā bhṛśam /
abhyamaṃsta bhavābhogavibhramāṇām asaṃnidhim // [AgMsv_2.143]
quick_english: But right here, the intellect of our earlier teachers strongly affirmed the non-presence of the delusions of worldly experience.

tokens.grounds: contrastive particle, sandhi form of tu

label: AgMsv_2.144
cite_parts:
vedasāṃkhyabhavedvādanyāyasaugatalaukikaiḥ /
pañcarātrakriyāśāstrasiddhāntādibhir alam // [AgMsv_2.144]
quick_english: Enough with the Vedic, Samkhya, dualist, logical, Buddhist, and worldly views, and with Pancaratra, ritual scriptures, Siddhanta, and the rest.

tokens.grounds: instrumental plural compound listing rival systems
instrumental plural compound listing other scriptural systems

label: AgMsv_2.145
cite_parts:
ucitocitavijñānakriyāṃśaparibhāvakaiḥ /
sarvaiḥ svaprakriyārūḍhais tais tair aucityayogataḥ // [AgMsv_2.145]
quick_english: All those various practitioners, cultivating the fitting portions of knowledge and action and established in their own procedures, act according to what is appropriate for them.

label: AgMsv_2.146
cite_parts:
yatra bījasamāvāpakhananādikriyākramaḥ /
akāri śāmbhavānekaśākhābhir yo 'tivistṛtaḥ // [AgMsv_2.146]
quick_english: Where the very extensive sequence of acts such as sowing, implanting, and digging was carried out by the many branches of the Shambhava teaching.

tokens.grounds: subject; compound describing ritual/agricultural metaphorical sequence
predicate adjective; sandhi form of ativistṛtaḥ

label: AgMsv_2.147
cite_parts:
tasya cidbhairavataroḥ phalam etad anuttaram /
āśramasthitacaryādyair jaṭājālāñjanāntakaiḥ // [AgMsv_2.147]
quick_english: The unsurpassed fruit of that tree of consciousness-Bhairava is this, beyond practices such as life-stage observances and even ascetic marks like matted hair and ointments.

tokens.grounds: instrumental plural compound describing ascetic marks

label: AgMsv_2.148
cite_parts:
kṛtair apy akṛtair vāpi yatra no labhyate bhidā /
tatraiva yoge viśrāntiṃ kurvatāṃ bhavaḍambaraḥ // [AgMsv_2.148]
quick_english: Where no difference is found between what is done and what is not done, for those who rest in that very yoga the pageantry of worldly existence dissolves.

tokens.grounds: concessive particle, sandhi form of api

label: AgMsv_2.149
cite_parts:
himānīva mahāgrīṣme svayam eva pralīyate /
alaṃ hi carvyamāṇe 'smin sarase saṃvidāsave // [AgMsv_2.149]
quick_english: Like a mass of snow in the great summer, it melts away by itself; for when this juicy nectar of awareness is savored, that is enough.

tokens.grounds: demonstrative in locative absolute, sandhi form of asmin

label: AgMsv_2.150
cite_parts:
nissaranti mahollāsāḥ saṃkhyā yeṣu na vidyate /
teṣāṃ ca prakaṭīkārāḥ kṛtāḥ prāg eva vistarāt /
atrābhinavagupte tu tattve ke 'py eva niścitāḥ // [AgMsv_2.150]
quick_english: Great raptures flow forth, of which there is no number; their manifestations were already set out at length before, but here in Abhinavagupta's treatment only some are definitively stated.

tokens.grounds: locative compound referring to the author/work context
emphatic particle, sandhi form of api

label: AgMsv_2.151
cite_parts:
ketakīkusumasaurabhe bhṛśaṃ \ \ bhṛṅga eva rasiko na makṣikā /
bhairavīyaparamādvayārcane \ \ ko 'pi rajyati na bhedamohitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.151]
quick_english: In the rich fragrance of the ketaki flower, the bee alone is the connoisseur, not the fly; likewise, in the worship of the supreme nondual Bhairava, some rare one delights, not one deluded by duality.

tokens.grounds: emphatic particle, sandhi form of api

label: AgMsv_2.152
cite_parts:
nātra rūḍhasya kāryā syāc chuddhiḥ kācana kutracit /
aśuddhaṃ hi jagaty eva bhairavātmani kiṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_2.152]
quick_english: For one established here, no purification of any kind would need to be done anywhere; for what in the world, whose very nature is Bhairava, could be impure?

tokens.grounds: optative of as, sandhi form of syāt

label: AgMsv_2.153
cite_parts:
aśuddhe 'pi ca bhūtaughe kena śuddhiḥ pratāyatām /
anavasthā bhaved itthaṃ vyarthānyonyāśritis tathā // [AgMsv_2.153]
quick_english: And even if the mass of beings were impure, by what means could purification be effected? In that way there would be infinite regress and likewise a futile mutual dependence.

tokens.grounds: concessive particle, sandhi form of api

label: AgMsv_2.154
cite_parts:
aśuddhasya tirodhāne śuddhaṃ nāma pralīyate /
pratiyogikṛtaṃ tad dhi na svabhāvena nīlavat // [AgMsv_2.154]
quick_english: When the impure is concealed, what is called the pure dissolves as well; for that is constituted by its opposite and is not established by its own nature, like blue.

tokens.grounds: demonstrative subject, sandhi form of tat
explanatory particle, sandhi form of hi

label: AgMsv_2.155
cite_parts:
ata eva na kaścid āgraho \ \ viṣayāṇāṃ grahaṇe 'py apohane /
parabhairavasaṃvidātmanaḥ \ \ svayam evocchalitā hi bhoktṛtā // [AgMsv_2.155]
quick_english: Therefore there is no insistence at all on either grasping or rejecting sense objects; for one whose nature is the consciousness of supreme Bhairava, enjoyership surges forth by itself.

tokens.grounds: concessive particle, sandhi form of api
genitive of the realized person; compound
past passive participle; sandhi of eva + ucchalitā

label: AgMsv_2.156
cite_parts:
sarvam atra vihitaṃ yato 'munā \ \ vartmanā sakalam eva yujyate /
mārgam evam apahastya kiṃcana \ \ kāpi naiva nanu yāti yuktatām // [AgMsv_2.156]
quick_english: Since everything established here fits together by this path, the whole system is coherent. If one rejects this path, surely no other approach attains any coherence at all.

label: AgMsv_2.157
cite_parts:
tathāhi dīkṣā nāmeyaṃ yā malānāṃ nikartanī /
sa bhedavādināṃ pakṣe kathaṃ nāmopapadyate // [AgMsv_2.157]
quick_english: For example, initiation is that which cuts away impurities; but how can this possibly be explained in the view of those who assert difference?

label: AgMsv_2.158
cite_parts:
tathāhi yo malo nāma sa kathaṃ citsvabhāvakam /
ātmānam āvṛṇīte kva vibhor āvaraṇakriyā // [AgMsv_2.158]
quick_english: For how can the so-called impurity cover a self whose nature is consciousness? And where is there any act of covering for an all-pervading being?

label: AgMsv_2.159
cite_parts:
na ca prakāśas tamasā jātu saṃvriyate yataḥ /
prakāśodaya evāyaṃ dhvāntadhvaṃsakriyātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_2.159]
quick_english: Light is never covered by darkness, because the very arising of light is an act that destroys darkness.

label: AgMsv_2.160
cite_parts:
kiṃ cāvaraṇam uktaṃ hi raśmyāder gatidharmiṇaḥ /
pratīghātātmakaṃ tat kiṃ vibhor agatidharmiṇaḥ // [AgMsv_2.160]
quick_english: Moreover, covering is said to be an obstruction of something that moves, like rays; so how could that apply to an all-pervading being that has no motion?

label: AgMsv_2.161
cite_parts:
api vā jñeyatāmātratirodhānaṃ hi saṃvṛteḥ /
paṭādinā ghaṭādeḥ syān na svarūpānyathāsthitiḥ // [AgMsv_2.161]
quick_english: Or else, covering is merely the concealment of knowability, as when a pot is covered by a cloth; it is not an alteration of its own nature.

label: AgMsv_2.162
cite_parts:
na cātmānaś cidātmatvāj jñeyatvam adhiśerate /
tadāvaraṇam eṣāṃ tu śabdeṣv api na śobhate // [AgMsv_2.162]
quick_english: But selves, because they are of the nature of consciousness, do not admit knowability; so to speak of their being covered is not fitting even in words.

label: AgMsv_2.163
cite_parts:
nanv īśvarasya te jñeyā aṇavaḥ katham īdṛśam /
cidātmakaṃ hi na jñeyaṃ cidātmatvatirohiteḥ // [AgMsv_2.163]
quick_english: But surely, one objects, those atomic selves are knowable to the Lord. How so? For what is of the nature of consciousness is not knowable, since that would conceal its conscious nature.

label: AgMsv_2.164
cite_parts:
saṃvij jñeyeti śabdo 'yaṃ vandhyā me jananītyadaḥ /
vākyaṃ smarayatīva svaṃ svātmasabrahmacāri yat // [AgMsv_2.164]
quick_english: The expression 'awareness is knowable' seems to recall its own fellow, the statement 'my mother is barren,' since both are self-contradictory.

label: AgMsv_2.165
cite_parts:
kiṃceśvarasya sārvajñyaṃ tāvatā pratihanyate /
āvṛtān vetti nāṇūn yan na tv eṣāṃ kācana kṣatiḥ // [AgMsv_2.165]
quick_english: Moreover, the Lord's omniscience would be impaired to that extent, because he would not know the covered atomic selves; yet there would be no harm to the selves themselves.

label: AgMsv_2.166
cite_parts:
nanv anāvaraṇe nīle jñātur āvaraṇe sati /
na darśanaṃ tathā bādhā na sarvajño malāvṛtaḥ // [AgMsv_2.166]
quick_english: But surely, when a blue object is uncovered the knower sees it, and when it is covered there is no seeing; likewise, one might say, an omniscient being covered by impurity would be obstructed.

label: AgMsv_2.167
cite_parts:
maivaṃ tatra hi dṛgraśmīn gacchataḥ pratihanti tat /
paṭādi na tu vijñātur asty āvaraṇasaṃbhavaḥ // [AgMsv_2.167]
quick_english: Not so. In that case, a cloth obstructs the outgoing rays of sight, but there is no possibility of covering the knower himself.

label: AgMsv_2.168
cite_parts:
malaś cāvyāpako vyāptur āvāraka iti sphuṭam /
ghaṭe 'pi vyomni saṃdadhyād aśūnyatvaṃ svarūpataḥ // [AgMsv_2.168]
quick_english: It is clear that a non-pervading impurity cannot be the coverer of what is all-pervading; even in a pot, it would by its own nature make space non-empty only in a limited way.

label: AgMsv_2.169
cite_parts:
ātmanaś cādhikāryatvān malaḥ kiṃcitkaro na cet /
katham āvaraṇāyaiṣa śakto nanu ca bhoḥ kimu // [AgMsv_2.169]
quick_english: And if impurity produces no effect because the self is not subject to modification, how can it be capable of covering? Surely, sir, what then?

label: AgMsv_2.170
cite_parts:
malasadbhāvamātraṃ hi tasyāvaraṇam ucyate /
malena sadvitīyo 'ṇur āvṛtaḥ paribhāṣyate // [AgMsv_2.170]
quick_english: Indeed, its covering is said to be merely the existence of impurity; the atomic self is described as covered simply because it has impurity as a second.

label: AgMsv_2.171
cite_parts:
hantānena nayenaiṣa śivam uktātmanām api /
sthitam āvaraṇaṃ satyaṃ malasadbhāvamātrataḥ // [AgMsv_2.171]
quick_english: Alas, by this reasoning, even for those of the stated nature there would truly be a covering of Shiva, merely from the existence of impurity.

label: AgMsv_2.172
cite_parts:
kiṃcāvṛto malenātmā malam eva na vetti kim /
tadasaṃvedane tasya kiṃ malāntaram ucyate // [AgMsv_2.172]
quick_english: Moreover, if the self covered by impurity does not even know the impurity, then in that non-awareness of it, is another impurity to be posited?

label: AgMsv_2.173
cite_parts:
nanv ataḥ kiṃ malaṃ vettu tarhi vidyākale vinā /
sarvajñatvaṃ bhavet tac ca malaṃ viditam eva sat // [AgMsv_2.173]
quick_english: But what of it? Let it know the impurity. Then, without vidya and kala, there would be omniscience; and if the impurity were known, the self could abandon it by various contrived means.

label: AgMsv_2.174
cite_parts:
jahātv ātmābhyupāyais tais tair vicitraiḥ prakalpitaiḥ /
kiṃcāvaraṇam etena yasyātmani bhavet tataḥ // [AgMsv_2.174]
quick_english: Let the self abandon it by those various contrived means; and if so, what covering would that impurity produce in the self?

label: AgMsv_2.175
cite_parts:
ghaṭādau jñātṛkartṛtve katham asya bhaviṣyataḥ /
nanu vidyākale kiṃcijjñatvakartṛtvapade smṛte // [AgMsv_2.175]
quick_english: How would this self come to be a knower and doer with respect to pots and such things? Surely, one replies, because vidya and kala are held to be the basis of limited knowing and doing.

label: AgMsv_2.176
cite_parts:
itthaṃ vimūḍhamatayo vañcyante na tu paṇḍitāḥ /
jaḍasvabhāvā māyaiṣā tatsūtiś ca kalādikaḥ // [AgMsv_2.176]
quick_english: In this way the deluded are deceived, but not the wise: this maya is inert by nature, and kala and the rest are its offspring.

label: AgMsv_2.177
cite_parts:
acidātmā kathaṃkāraṃ cidabhivyañjanakṣamaḥ /
abhivyaktā ca cidvibhvī kiṃcittvādiviśeṣaṇaiḥ // [AgMsv_2.177]
quick_english: How could what is non-conscious be capable of manifesting consciousness? And if all-pervading consciousness were manifested, how could it be qualified by limitedness and such attributes?

label: AgMsv_2.178
cite_parts:
viśeṣyatāṃ kathaṃ nāma sāṃśavastūcitaṃ hi tat /
nanu devaḥ kalāvidyākaraṇo vyañjayec citam // [AgMsv_2.178]
quick_english: How could it become qualified? For that is fitting only for things that have parts. But surely, one objects, God, using kala and vidya, could manifest consciousness.

label: AgMsv_2.179
cite_parts:
vyanaktu sarvato hanta nāsyāśaktir athāgrahaḥ /
male sadātane cāsya kathaṃ muktir bhaviṣyati // [AgMsv_2.179]
quick_english: Let him manifest it in all ways—alas, there is no incapacity in him. But if there is insistence on an eternal impurity, how will liberation ever come about?

label: AgMsv_2.180
cite_parts:
roddhrī śaktir malasyāsti sā ca kvāpi nivartate /
kvāpi pravartate ceti dhig idaṃ mūḍhabhāṣitam // [AgMsv_2.180]
quick_english: The claim that impurity has an obstructing power which sometimes stops and sometimes acts is foolish talk.

tokens.grounds: adjective describing the power of mala
sandhi fusion of malasya + asti; mala possesses a power
describes the power stopping in some case
describes the power acting in another case
sandhi fusion of ca + iti marking reported claim

label: AgMsv_2.181
cite_parts:
jaḍānāṃ ko 'nusandhiḥ syāt taṃ vinaitat kathaṃ bhavet /
atha tatrāpi devasya hetutābhyupagamyate // [AgMsv_2.181]
quick_english: Insentient things cannot deliberate, so how could that selective operation happen? If so, one must admit that God is the cause even in that case.

tokens.grounds: refers to inert entities like mala or its power
elided initial a; capacity for intentional connection
sandhi fusion of tatra + api; even in that case

label: AgMsv_2.182
cite_parts:
kiṃ nimittam asau devas tāṃ śaktiṃ saṃpravartayet /
pravartitāṃ vā kiṃ nāma tāṃ nivartayate punaḥ // [AgMsv_2.182]
quick_english: For what reason would that God set that power in motion, or for what reason would he make it stop again once it has been set in motion?

tokens.grounds: subject who would activate the power
questions God's motive for stopping it

label: AgMsv_2.183
cite_parts:
svātantryād iti cet pūrṇaṃ tad evāśrīyate na kim /
malasya dhvāntarūpasya na ca pāko 'pi kaścana // [AgMsv_2.183]
quick_english: If the answer is that God acts from autonomy, then let that plenitude alone be accepted. Why bring in impurity, which is of the nature of darkness, and why suppose any maturation of it at all?

tokens.grounds: sandhi fusion of eva + āśrīyate; accept plenitude directly
rhetorical question challenging need for mala
doctrine of mala ripening is denied

label: AgMsv_2.184
cite_parts:
sa hy anyatādānayogād dhanty amuṣya dhruvātmatām /
etena malasaṃbandhād īśvarecchāpracoditaḥ // [AgMsv_2.184]
quick_english: For maturation, by involving a connection with another state, would destroy mala's fixed nature. By this reasoning, the idea that a soul is impelled by God's will because of its connection with impurity is refuted.

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of hi; gives reason
maturation would imply acquiring another state
sandhi form before amuṣya; maturation would destroy permanence
permanent essence that would be contradicted
compound describing the soul's supposed motivation

label: AgMsv_2.185
cite_parts:
bhogalobhakathāviṣṭaḥ paśuḥ sṛṣṭyānugṛhyate /
iti yad bhaṇyate mūlahataṃ taj, janitaṃ tataḥ // [AgMsv_2.185]
quick_english: The claim that the bound soul, caught up in the desire for enjoyment, is favored by creation is struck at the root; that consequence follows from what has been shown.

tokens.grounds: subject said to be favored by creation
sandhi fusion of sṛṣṭyā + anugṛhyate; opponent's claim
evaluates the doctrine as fundamentally refuted
sandhi form of tat; refers to the doctrine
states the consequence has been generated

label: AgMsv_2.186
cite_parts:
svātmapracchādanakrīḍāmātram eva malaṃ viduḥ /
svatantro hi vibhuḥ kiṃcit kiṃ na svātmani bhāsayet // [AgMsv_2.186]
quick_english: They know impurity to be nothing but the mere play of concealing one's own self. For why would the autonomous, all-pervading Lord not manifest anything within himself?

tokens.grounds: compound defining mala in the nondual view
affirms the Lord's freedom to appear as concealment

label: AgMsv_2.187
cite_parts:
yac ca karmāpi nāmeṣṭaṃ tattāvat pravicāryatām /
tathāhi karmasaṃbandhe sthite 'pi katham īdṛśaḥ // [AgMsv_2.187]
quick_english: And as for karma, which is also accepted, let that first be examined. For even if the connection with karma remains, how can there be such a state as the great dissolution?

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of yat; introduces next topic
sandhi fusion of karma + api; extends discussion to karma
sandhi fusion of nāma + iṣṭam; opponent accepts karma
sandhi fusion of tat + tāvat; calls for prior examination
refers to the great dissolution described next

label: AgMsv_2.188
cite_parts:
mahāpralaya ucyate mahāsṛṣṭiś ca vā katham /
nanv īśvarecchayā tatra karmāyāti niruddhatām // [AgMsv_2.188]
quick_english: How can there be a great dissolution, or a great creation? Surely, one may say, karma becomes restrained there by the will of God.

quick_english: But if, without depending on karma, he restrains karmas, then let the all-pervading Lord keep them restrained always.

quick_english: For the intrinsic nature of things is independent. Therefore, whatever form karmas have when they do not depend on the Lord's direction—that is their own true nature.

compound describing karmas apart from divine prompting

sandhi fusion of svabhāvāt + tat + tādṛk; karma is such by nature

label: AgMsv_2.201

bījam aṅkurasaṃsūtisvabhāvam iti mādṛśaḥ // [AgMsv_2.202]
quick_english: To say that the Śaiva teaching, or that karmas, are such by their own nature—what principle is that? People like us know that a seed has the nature of producing a sprout.

tokens.grounds: refers to Śaiva scripture or teaching
sandhi form of svabhāvaḥ; invoked as explanation

label: AgMsv_2.203

pūrvavṛddhavyavahṛter vijñātuṃ prabhaviṣṇavaḥ /
īśvaras tu nijecchayā vinā na hi kadācana // [AgMsv_2.203]
quick_english: People like us are able to know such things from the established usage of earlier generations. But the Lord, indeed, never acts without his own will.

tokens.grounds: sandhi form of īśvaraḥ; contrasted subject

label: AgMsv_2.204
cite_parts:
avalokitavān karmaphalavaicitryacāturīm /

no kartāras te 'pi cet karmavandhyān uddiśyainān sarvakartā na devaḥ // [AgMsv_2.204]
quick_english: Having observed the intricate diversity of karmic fruits, if the Lord alone were the doer of everything, the group of individual selves could in no way be doers. But if they too are not doers, then, aiming at these beings barren of action, the Lord would not be the all-doer.

tokens.grounds: ablative demonstrative used as conclusion marker

label: AgMsv_2.205
cite_parts:

etāvān atra saṃkṣopo vyāso 'nyatra tu darśitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.205]
quick_english: Thus, from the standpoint of duality, this so-called karma is not well-reasoned. Here only a brief summary is given, while the fuller elaboration has been shown elsewhere.

tokens.grounds: compound bheda+dṛṣṭi fused with idam by sandhi
locative adverb referring to this context

label: AgMsv_2.206
cite_parts:

sarvakartā sa vaicitryāt karmayogīti bhaṇyate // [AgMsv_2.206]
quick_english: The Lord is one, whose very nature is consciousness; therefore he is indeed the all-doer by his own nature. Because of diversity, he is spoken of as connected with karma.

tokens.grounds: compound karma+yoga fused with iti by sandhi

label: AgMsv_2.207
cite_parts:
māyā ca nāma viśvasya yā kāraṇam iti sthitā /
sā dharaṇyantatattvāṃśagarbhā nityā yadi sphuṭam // [AgMsv_2.207]
quick_english: And that so-called Maya, which is established as the cause of the universe, containing within her womb the elements of the tattvas ending with earth—if she is clearly eternal...

tokens.grounds: that of which Maya is cause

label: AgMsv_2.208
cite_parts:
pralayo na kadācit syān nanu sa vyaktibhāvataḥ /
vyaktiṃ nāma na jānīmo vijñānaṃ grāhyatā yataḥ // [AgMsv_2.208]
quick_english: Then dissolution would never occur. But surely it occurs through the state of manifestation? We do not recognize manifestation as such, because cognition consists in being an object of grasping.

label: AgMsv_2.209
cite_parts:
tadīśvaraparajñānagrāhyatāsti sadātanī /
tasyām avidyamānāyām īśvaraḥ kāraṇaṃ kutaḥ // [AgMsv_2.209]
quick_english: Its being grasped by the Lord's supreme knowledge is everlasting. If that were absent, how could the Lord be the cause?

tokens.grounds: compound tad+īśvara+para+jñāna+grāhyatā fused with asti by sandhi
present participle of vid with a-

label: AgMsv_2.210
cite_parts:
sphuṭaṃ prakurute kumbhaṃ tadvad īśe bhaviṣyati /
maivam antarbahīrūpakaraṇapravibhedataḥ // [AgMsv_2.210]
quick_english: One might think it will be in the Lord as when someone clearly produces a pot. Not so, because of the distinction between inner and outer instruments.

label: AgMsv_2.211
cite_parts:
sphuṭāsphuṭādivijñānaṃ yuktaṃ kumbhakṛti sphuṭam /
īśvarasya sphuṭodārapūrvavijñānaśālinaḥ // [AgMsv_2.211]
quick_english: In the making of a pot, cognition that is clear, unclear, and so forth is fitting; but the Lord possesses a clear, noble, prior cognition.

label: AgMsv_2.212
cite_parts:
ko na jñāto bhaved bhāgo yatrāpi vyaktyapekṣitā /
satkāryavādināṃ deśe kāraṇe 'pi sphuṭaṃ sthitam // [AgMsv_2.212]
quick_english: What part would not be known, even where dependence on manifestation is assumed? In the view of the satkarya theorists, the universe is clearly established even in the cause.

label: AgMsv_2.213
cite_parts:
viśvam ityapi māyāyāṃ sphuṭaṃ syād asamañjasam /
vyāpakāś ca śivātmānas tattvaiḥ sākaṃ parasparam // [AgMsv_2.213]
quick_english: Thus, for the universe to be clearly present in Maya would be incongruous, since Siva and the selves are pervasive, together with the tattvas and mutually so.

label: AgMsv_2.214
cite_parts:
kathaṃ ca nāma vidyantāṃ vyāpakatvatirohiteḥ /
vikāsaḥ paramo vyāptiḥ saṃvido bheda ucyate // [AgMsv_2.214]
quick_english: And how indeed could they exist, given the concealment of pervasiveness? The supreme expansion of consciousness is its pervasion, and in division it is spoken of accordingly.

label: AgMsv_2.215
cite_parts:
māyīyaṃ kañcukavrātaṃ yathā karaṇasaṃcayaḥ /
vicāritaḥ pūrvam eva kāryavargaś ca carcitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.215]
quick_english: The group of coverings born of Maya, as well as the collection of instruments, has already been examined before, and the group of effects has also been discussed.

tokens.grounds: compound kārya+varga with sandhi for ca

label: AgMsv_2.216
cite_parts:
yāvac chivapadādhyāsavandhyaṃ viśvaṃ na visphuret /
tatsvātantryakathāmātram etad ity avadhāryatām // [AgMsv_2.216]
quick_english: As long as the universe, devoid of resting on the state of Siva, does not shine forth, this is merely talk of its autonomy; let that be understood.

label: AgMsv_2.217
cite_parts:
evaṃ malādyabhāve hi kā dīkṣā ko hi dīkṣakaḥ /
dīkṣāpātraṃ ca ko vā syād iti kiṃcin na yujyate // [AgMsv_2.217]
quick_english: Thus, in the absence of impurity and the like, what initiation could there be, who would be the initiator, and who the recipient? None of this fits.

label: AgMsv_2.218
cite_parts:
śiṣye 'dhvany anale kumbhe maṇḍale srukkarādike /
samastādhvakṛto nyāsaḥ kathaṃ vāpy upapadyatām // [AgMsv_2.218]
quick_english: How could the installation of the entire path in the disciple, the path, the fire, the vessel, the mandala, the ladle, the hand, and so on, be possible?

label: AgMsv_2.219
cite_parts:
nahi tāvanta eva syur nanu saṃkalpanāvaśāt /
śodhyaśodhakabhāvo 'yaṃ sarva evodito nanu // [AgMsv_2.219]
quick_english: Surely they would not all be present in that way. But, one may object, by the power of conception this entire relation of purifier and purified has indeed been declared.

tokens.grounds: refers to the full extent of the path
eva fused with uditaḥ by sandhi

label: AgMsv_2.220
cite_parts:
kalpitaṃ cet phalet satyaṃ manorājyārjitaśriyaḥ /
jayanti nākasāmrājyalābhaviśrāntiyogataḥ // [AgMsv_2.220]
quick_english: If what is merely imagined could bear fruit, then truly those who have gained riches in the kingdom of fantasy would triumph by attaining the repose of heavenly sovereignty.

label: AgMsv_2.221
cite_parts:
kiṃ nāma balavadrūpasaṃkalpapathavartinaḥ /
phalanti na tathā bhāvā dhyānādiviṣanāśavat // [AgMsv_2.221]

label: AgMsv_2.222
cite_parts:

dhyānaṃ ca na phaled eva svayaṃ pakṣadvayāgrahāt // [AgMsv_2.222]
quick_english: Meditation is precisely firmness of conception; but meditation tainted by doubt does not bear fruit at all, because it grasps two alternatives.

label: AgMsv_2.223
cite_parts:
hanta saṃkalpanāyogād yadi jāyeta tatphalam /
kim asaṃvinmayān bhāvān bāhyān kāṃścit abhīpsasi // [AgMsv_2.223]
quick_english: Look—if its fruit were to arise from the application of conception, why would you desire some external entities that are not made of consciousness?

tokens.grounds: exclamatory particle introducing a sharp point

label: AgMsv_2.224
cite_parts:
saṃkalpenaiva saṃskāraḥ kuṇḍāgniguruśiṣyagaḥ /
sa eva ca phalābhāsī tatsaṃvid avaśiṣyate // [AgMsv_2.224]
quick_english: By conception alone there is consecration pertaining to the pit, fire, guru, and disciple; and that same thing, appearing as the fruit, remains as that consciousness.

tokens.grounds: instrumental of saṃkalpa fused with eva

label: AgMsv_2.225
cite_parts:
saṃvidaś ca svatantrāyās tathārūpāvabhāsanam /
dīkṣeti kila mantavyaṃ muñcyante jantavo yayā // [AgMsv_2.225]
quick_english: And the manifestation in such a form of autonomous consciousness should indeed be understood as initiation, by which beings are liberated.

tokens.grounds: dīkṣā fused with iti by sandhi

label: AgMsv_2.226
cite_parts:
ata eva tilājyādeḥ svarūpe grahaṇe mitau /
kramo vā niyamo neha kaścic chāstre nirūpitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.226]
quick_english: For that very reason, no sequence or fixed rule has been determined here in the scripture regarding the essential nature, taking, or measure of sesame, ghee, and the like.

label: AgMsv_2.227
cite_parts:
nanu mantreṣu kiṃ nāma niyamaḥ sarvavarṇabhāk /

quick_english: But surely, what fixed rule is there in mantras? For the supreme form is declared to partake of all letters; so how could initiation not be the same way?

label: AgMsv_2.228
cite_parts:

quick_english: Thus, the burning of letters as you approve it is indeed beneficial; but for those who have not yet attained firm establishment, a definite rule certainly applies to them.

label: AgMsv_2.229

quick_english: This mantric rule has been declared and it serves a real purpose, for those mantras are awakened and move along the path of reflective awareness.

quick_english: Because the light of consciousness is autonomous, the mantras, made of agency, enter that very teacher through the application of identity with it.

label: AgMsv_2.231
cite_parts:

itthaṃ dīkṣādividhaye ye 'py anye vidhayo matāḥ // [AgMsv_2.231]
quick_english: They make him autonomous, and even instruments attain agency; thus, initiation and whatever other rites are accepted become possible.

label: AgMsv_2.232
cite_parts:

te 'py atraivopapadyante tat sarvaṃ vihitaṃ tv iha // [AgMsv_2.232]
quick_english: What, indeed, is to be done by those who act, and how could there even be prohibition? Both are established right here, for all of that is enjoined here.

label: AgMsv_2.233
cite_parts:

pratiṣedhe darśite 'sya kiṃ cādvaitapathāśritaḥ // [AgMsv_2.233]
quick_english: And all this is prohibited only from that other standpoint; for when its prohibition is clearly shown, what force does it have for one who rests on the nondual path?

label: AgMsv_2.234
cite_parts:

itthaṃ svasaṃvidambhodhiḥ svātmani procchalaty alam // [AgMsv_2.234]
quick_english: Even prohibition is enjoined, and that too is prohibited; thus the ocean of one's own awareness surges abundantly within itself.

label: AgMsv_2.235
cite_parts:
itthaṃ ca viśvam evedaṃ jagadānandasundaram /
tadvipakṣaṃ ca bhedāṃśam itthaṃ kṣapayatetarām // [AgMsv_2.235]
quick_english: Thus this entire universe is beautiful with the bliss of the world, and in this way it utterly dissolves the opposing element of difference.

label: AgMsv_2.236
cite_parts:

tāvatā svaprabhābhārabhāsvarāḥ sumarīcayaḥ // [AgMsv_2.236]
quick_english: From the moon of knowledge risen from the mouth of the Supreme Lord, beautiful rays radiant with the fullness of their own light spread in all directions.

label: AgMsv_2.237
cite_parts:

samastabhāvaśītāṃśukālakūṭo rasāyate // [AgMsv_2.237]
quick_english: The deadly poison that darkens the moon of all beings, melted by the mere touch of the mass of rays from Shiva's moon, turns into an elixir.

label: AgMsv_2.238
cite_parts:
tatrāniśaṃ nimajjantas tadrasāpānaghūrṇitāḥ /
tadrasībhūya tiṣṭhāmaḥ śuddhās tāpatrayojjhitāḥ // [AgMsv_2.238]
quick_english: Plunging there unceasingly and reeling from drinking that essence, we become that essence itself and abide pure, freed from the three kinds of suffering.

label: AgMsv_2.239
cite_parts:

pratipadyata īśvarādibhinnasthitivijñānaśaśāṅkaśaktivṛttam // [AgMsv_2.239]
quick_english: The mouth of the Supreme Lord is said to be his power, namely will; having arisen, that will takes on the functioning of the moon of knowledge in the distinct states beginning with Īśvara.

label: AgMsv_2.240
cite_parts:

iyam eva hi sā kriyātmikoktā parameśasya jaganmayī svaśaktiḥ // [AgMsv_2.240]
quick_english: The fully spread mass of rays streaming forth on all sides from that moon is indeed the Supreme Lord's own power, declared to consist of action and to be made of the world.

label: AgMsv_2.241
cite_parts:
tad idaṃ trikaśaktinirbharaṃ paramaṃ bhairavam eva jṛmbhate /
na tu tadvyatireki saṃbhavet svavijṛmbhā vijayo 'sya kīrtitaḥ // [AgMsv_2.241]
quick_english: Thus this, full of the three powers, expands as the supreme Bhairava alone; nothing different from it could exist, and its own expansion is proclaimed as its victory.

label: AgMsv_2.242
cite_parts:
tata eva jagaj jayanty amī sphuṭam arthaḥ prakaṭo 'pi yujyate naḥ /
bahuvācakayoga īdṛśaṃ tat paripūrṇatvam amuṣya vākyabhedam // [AgMsv_2.242]
quick_english: From that very reality these powers clearly conquer the world; the meaning becomes manifest and fits for us, since such a connection with many expressions belongs to that fullness and accommodates the division of statements.

label: AgMsv_2.243
cite_parts:
ity eka eva śloko 'yaṃ cidātmā bhairavaḥ svayam /
samastabhāvasaṃdarbhanirbharo vyākṛtaḥ sphuṭam // [AgMsv_2.243]
quick_english: Thus this single verse clearly explains Bhairava himself, whose nature is consciousness, full of the entire sequence of all beings.

label: AgMsv_2.244
cite_parts:
saṃsāragaranāśāya tārkṣyādhiṣṭhitadṛṣṭayaḥ /
viṣam evopayuñjānāḥ prāpnuvanty amṛtīṃ sthitim // [AgMsv_2.244]
quick_english: For the destruction of the poison of worldly existence, those whose vision is empowered by Garuda employ poison itself and attain an immortal state.

tokens.grounds: emphatic particle fused with present participle

label: AgMsv_2.245
cite_parts:
iti darśitam etāvat svaprakāśasvasaṃvidā /
siddhaṃ tadvyatirekeṇa na kiṃcid eva kalpate // [AgMsv_2.245]
quick_english: Thus it has been shown to this extent: by self-luminous own-awareness everything is established, and apart from that nothing at all is possible.

label: AgMsv_2.246
cite_parts:
yāvatsvasaṃvidviśrāntaṃ yat tāvat tat sad eva hi /
kālāntaravyapekṣe hi satyatvaṃ syān na kutracit // [AgMsv_2.246]
quick_english: Whatever rests in own-awareness is real to that very extent; for if reality depended on another time, it could not be real anywhere.

label: AgMsv_2.247
cite_parts:
saṃvidaḥ kālayogaś ca vistareṇa nivāritaḥ /
tat svasaṃvid yathā deśaṃ vitared vartate tathā // [AgMsv_2.247]
quick_english: The connection of awareness with time has been refuted at length; therefore own-awareness functions just as it spreads out space.

label: AgMsv_2.248
cite_parts:
tathā saṃvidy akṣamayyāṃ nikaṣāśmani ropitam /
na yat tat saṃśayāyaiva śāstre 'py uktam avastu tat // [AgMsv_2.248]
quick_english: Likewise, whatever cannot be placed on the touchstone of awareness is fit only for doubt; even in scripture that is called unreal.

label: AgMsv_2.249
cite_parts:
svasaṃvid anupārohi pralāpān na viśiṣyate /
tac cchāstraṃ prakriyā sā ca yat saṃvidi vivartate // [AgMsv_2.249]
quick_english: What does not rise to own-awareness is no different from idle talk; that alone is scripture and that alone is method which unfolds within awareness.

label: AgMsv_2.250
cite_parts:
hṛdayāj jagato jātāḥ sarvasyaite kṣayodayāḥ /
svapnasyeva suṣuptākhyāt svasaṃvicchāstracarcitāḥ // [AgMsv_2.250]
quick_english: All these risings and settings of the whole world arise from the heart, like a dream from deep sleep, and are examined by the scripture of own-awareness.

label: AgMsv_2.251
cite_parts:
rūpālokamanaskārasāmagrī saṃhṛtiḥ sthitiḥ /
sṛṣṭir nimeṣonmeṣau ca satāṃ saṃkocakalpanam // [AgMsv_2.251]
quick_english: The totality of form, light, and attention; withdrawal, maintenance, and creation; closing and opening; and the construction of contraction in beings — all these are its operations.

label: AgMsv_2.252
cite_parts:
ityādikā mātṛmeyamānarūpā sthitiḥ sadā /
svasaṃvidaḥ supūrṇāyāḥ prapañcaracanā svayam // [AgMsv_2.252]
quick_english: Such an abiding state, having the form of knower, known, and knowing, is always the spontaneous fashioning of the manifold world by perfectly full own-consciousness.

tokens.grounds: points to the preceding description of manifestation
compound describing the triadic structure of manifestation
refers to self-awareness as the source

label: AgMsv_2.253
cite_parts:
sarvasarvātmadigdeśakālākārā svayaṃ hi sā /
satyamithyātvanirṇītis tata eva hi jāyate // [AgMsv_2.253]
quick_english: She indeed is by herself the form of all, of all selves, directions, places, and times; and from her alone arises the determination of what is true and what is false.

tokens.grounds: compound expressing total pervasion of consciousness
the capacity to discern reality and unreality
points to consciousness as the source

label: AgMsv_2.254
cite_parts:
ācāryotpaladevo 'pi tadetadupadiṣṭavān /
bahiḥ sadasadātmāpi svasaṃvidi madīyadṛk // [AgMsv_2.254]
quick_english: Teacher Utpaladeva also taught this very thing: even what appears outside as being or nonbeing is, in own-consciousness, my seeing.

tokens.grounds: adds this authority to the argument
describes the ambiguous status of external objects
locates the true ground of appearance
identifies perception as rooted in self-awareness

label: AgMsv_2.255
cite_parts:
paśyatv iti svatantrasya niyatiḥ sendriyābhidhā /
saiva rūdhā śivād ā ca krimeḥ svāṃ saṃvidaṃ śritā // [AgMsv_2.255]
quick_english: The regulation of the autonomous, expressed as 'let it see' and called together with the senses, is that very consciousness which, ascending from Shiva down to the worm, rests upon its own awareness.

tokens.grounds: imperative expressing the freedom of consciousness
the self-imposed order of the free
names this regulation as inclusive of the senses
the self-awareness that is rested upon

label: AgMsv_2.256
cite_parts:
tad eva deve saṃsāraḥ sa śivaḥ parameīŭvaraḥ /
tatra viśrāntim āpanno mukta ity abhidhīyate // [AgMsv_2.256]
quick_english: That very same reality is worldly bondage, and it is Shiva, the supreme lord; one who has attained rest in it is called liberated.

tokens.grounds: locates the state in the divine
one who has reached that rest

label: AgMsv_2.257
cite_parts:
etatprasādāj jīvanti brahmādyāḥ sthāvarāntakāḥ /
aviluptā sadā seyaṃ saṃvittir iti gṛhyatām // [AgMsv_2.257]
quick_english: By the grace of this, all beings from Brahma down to the immobile live; let this consciousness be understood as always unobscured.

tokens.grounds: states the dependence of all beings
includes the lowest forms of existence
points to the consciousness under discussion

label: AgMsv_2.258
cite_parts:
vibhānty api hi sā devī na tayā rahitaṃ kvacit /
ātmānaṃ sādhayet kvāpi kvāpi dūṣayate kvacit // [AgMsv_2.258]
quick_english: Even while shining forth, that goddess never establishes a self anywhere as devoid of her; in one place she may establish it, in another fault it, in another do otherwise.

tokens.grounds: names consciousness in its divine aspect
the self that is established or altered

label: AgMsv_2.259
cite_parts:
anyathaiva sthāpayate na ca yāti vikāritām /
sādhandūṣaṇānyatvavandhyāpi parameśvarī // [AgMsv_2.259]
quick_english: She places things otherwise, yet she does not undergo change; even while barren of establishing, faulting, and otherness, she remains the supreme goddess.

tokens.grounds: compound stating she is untouched by her own operations
names consciousness in its sovereign aspect

label: AgMsv_2.260
cite_parts:
bhāsate ca tathātvena tat svatantrā sphuṭā hi sā /
śrīmān maheśvaro devaḥ pūrveṣām api yo guruḥ // [AgMsv_2.260]
quick_english: And she shines clearly in that very way, autonomous indeed; she is the glorious great lord, the god who is the teacher even of those who came before.

tokens.grounds: refers to prior teachers or beings

label: AgMsv_2.261
cite_parts:
sa etad eva provāca lokānugrahahetutaḥ /

mūḍhāḥ kiṃ niḥsāre vāyasaviraṭitakalpe tiṣṭatha vacasi vṛthaivaṃ svāṃ saṃvidam āvarjya /
saṃviddevatayaiva yad ādiṣṭaṃ nikaṭe 'py atha sarva ādriyamāṇās tattaddeśe jīvanmuktā bhavanti // [AgMsv_2.261]
quick_english: He proclaimed this for the grace of the world: 'Deluded ones, why do you abide in vain in essenceless speech like the cawing of crows? Honoring your own consciousness, all who respect what is instructed even nearby by the goddess-consciousness become liberated while living, in whatever place they are.'

tokens.grounds: the true ground to be honored

label: AgMsv_2.262
cite_parts:
tad atra nītau saṃvittir evāsau gurur ucyate /
giraty eva yato viśvaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhṛtiyogataḥ // [AgMsv_2.262]
quick_english: Therefore, in this guiding principle, consciousness alone is called the teacher, because it indeed swallows the universe through creation and dissolution.

tokens.grounds: the modes by which it swallows the universe

label: AgMsv_2.263
cite_parts:
tad atra mukhyā yā rūḍhiḥ saṃbandhaḥ para ucyate /
enayā yad yad ādiṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ sāṃsiddhikaṃ tu tat // [AgMsv_2.263]
quick_english: Therefore, here the primary firm relation is called the supreme one; whatever knowledge is instructed through it is indeed innately accomplished.

label: AgMsv_2.264
cite_parts:
yatrāsmadguruvargasya sthitā nityāvasthitiḥ /
traiyambakādisaṃtānabhedo yasmāt pravartate // [AgMsv_2.264]
quick_english: Where the eternal abiding of our lineage of teachers is established, from there proceeds the division of the transmission beginning with Tryambaka.

tokens.grounds: the unchanging condition of the lineage
indicates the source of the lineage
describes the unfolding of the tradition

label: AgMsv_2.265
cite_parts:
yatroktaṃ pūrvam ajñānatādātmyaṃ naśyatītyapi /
svasaṃvidas tu vaicitryaṃ gṛhṇatyā bhāty ayaṃ tataḥ // [AgMsv_2.265]
quick_english: Where it was previously said that identity with ignorance perishes, this world shines forth from the variety grasped by own-consciousness.

tokens.grounds: the mistaken identification to be removed

label: AgMsv_2.266
cite_parts:
antarālamahaddivyādivyādi śāstrasaṃgamaḥ /
tattvavannijavāgaṃśūn guror ātmavinirmitān // [AgMsv_2.266]
quick_english: The confluence of scriptures—intermediate, great-divine, divine, and so forth—consists of the rays of the teacher's own true speech, fashioned by his own self.

tokens.grounds: classifies levels of scriptures or beings
describes teachings as rays of true speech
created by the teacher's own being

label: AgMsv_2.267
cite_parts:
prādhānyaṃ prakaṭaṃ svasaṃvidaḥ /
gurutaḥ kila śāstrataḥ svataḥ /
tad ayaṃ mukhyatayā kṛtaḥ śramaḥ // [AgMsv_2.267]
quick_english: The primacy of own-consciousness is manifest—whether from the teacher, from scripture, or from oneself; therefore this effort has been made with that as primary.

label: AgMsv_2.268
cite_parts:
śāstravṛttiparatantrito guruḥ svātmasaṃvidi ca tatpratiṣṭhitam /
tena sarvam idam ātmasaṃvidā siddhim eti nahi jātv asahyatām // [AgMsv_2.268]
quick_english: The teacher depends on the operation of scripture, and that is established in one's own self-consciousness; therefore all this attains accomplishment through self-consciousness and is never obstructed.

tokens.grounds: describes the teacher's reliance on scripture

label: AgMsv_2.269
cite_parts:
etac chāstraṃ prayatnena carcyatāṃ he mumukṣavaḥ /
mā vṛthaivāyur āyastam anyaśāstreṣu nīyatām // [AgMsv_2.269]
quick_english: O seekers of liberation, let this scripture be practiced with effort; do not let life be spent in vain, strained over other scriptures.

label: AgMsv_2.270
cite_parts:
abhedadṛṣṭir yā kācid bhedadṛṣṭir athāpi vā /
sātraivāyāti nirvāhaṃ tenaitat pravicāryatām // [AgMsv_2.270]
quick_english: Whatever view of non-difference or view of difference there may be, it comes to fulfillment here alone; therefore let this be carefully examined.

tokens.grounds: states where both views are resolved

label: AgMsv_2.271
cite_parts:
svapnakālaparijñānavī[tanidro] yathā tathā /
etacchāstrasamabhyāsaprabuddhahṛdayaḥ sadā // [AgMsv_2.271]
quick_english: Just as one is freed from sleep by recognizing the dream state, so one whose heart is awakened by sustained practice of this scripture remains always awake.

label: AgMsv_2.272
cite_parts:
svasaṃvid eva tac chāstraṃ sā cāpekṣāvivarjitā /
tathā yady abhidhīyeta svataḥ prāmāṇyam ucyatām // [AgMsv_2.272]
quick_english: Own-consciousness indeed is that scripture, and she is free from dependence; if it is to be stated thus, let its authoritativeness be said to be from itself.

tokens.grounds: the teaching in its deepest sense

label: AgMsv_2.273
cite_parts:
śāsanaṃ śāsitavyaṃ ca śāsakaṃ ceti yat kila /
tattatrākālakalitaṃ svātantryādvaitasundaram // [AgMsv_2.273]
quick_english: Teaching, what is to be taught, and the teacher—this triad, in that state, is not measured by time and is beautiful with freedom and nonduality.

tokens.grounds: the act or content of instruction

label: AgMsv_2.274
cite_parts:
tām avasthitim ātmīyāṃ garbhīkṛtyānapāyinīm /
śrīkaṇṭhanāthaḥ provāca śrīmatkiraṇaśāsane // [AgMsv_2.274]
quick_english: Having internalized that intrinsic, never-departing state, lord Shrikantha proclaimed it in the glorious Kirana scripture.

label: AgMsv_2.275
cite_parts:
sarvam etat pravṛttyarthaṃ śrot\rr ṇāṃ tu vibhedataḥ /
arthabhedāt tu bhedo 'yam upacārāt prakalpate // [AgMsv_2.275]
quick_english: All this is for the sake of engaging hearers through differentiation; but this difference, arising from difference of meaning, is constructed only by metaphorical usage.

tokens.grounds: continuation of the genitive plural ending
refers to the division in teaching
explains the status of the division
states that the division is provisional

label: AgMsv_2.276
cite_parts:
phalabhedo na kalpyo 'tra kalpyaś ced ayathātatham /
daśakāṣṭādaśāṣṭāṣṭabhedabhinnam idaṃ vibhoḥ // [AgMsv_2.276]
quick_english: No difference of fruit should be assumed here in the Lord's teaching; if one were assumed, it would be a false assumption, making this teaching of the Lord appear divided by distinctions of ten, eighteen, eight, and eight.

tokens.grounds: gerundive from kḷp; nominative singular with sandhi

label: AgMsv_2.277
cite_parts:
śivasadbhāvalābhaikaphalaṃ tallābhaprotsuke /
adhikāriṇy aṇau jātikulavarṇādyanādarāt // [AgMsv_2.277]
quick_english: This teaching has the single fruit of attaining the state of being Śiva, and it applies to the qualified individual soul who is eager for that attainment, without regard for birth, family, caste, and the like.

label: AgMsv_2.278
cite_parts:
pravṛttam ekavākyatvaṃ yāvad āsādya vartate /
aṅgāṅgivṛttavaicitryāt tāvad ekam idaṃ viduḥ // [AgMsv_2.278]
quick_english: As long as this teaching, once set forth, maintains its unity of discourse, the wise know it as one, even though there is variety in the functions of its subsidiary and principal parts.

label: AgMsv_2.279
cite_parts:
trikaśāstraṃ tathābhūto gurur atrādvayātmakaḥ /
tadanantaravākyāṃśapuñjaḥ prakaraṇāni ca // [AgMsv_2.279]
quick_english: The Trika scripture, the teacher who is of that nature and nondual here, and the collection of its subsequent textual portions and sections all belong to the same unified framework.

label: AgMsv_2.280
cite_parts:
māyīyabhedavṛttāntasphuṭabhāve bhavanti ca /
tathāpi śivasaṃprāptir mukhyam ante phalaṃ sthitam // [AgMsv_2.280]
quick_english: Even when the accounts of differences produced by māyā become clear, the attainment of Śiva remains established as the primary and final fruit.

tokens.grounds: compound: śiva-saṃprāptiḥ; nominative singular with sandhi

label: AgMsv_2.281
cite_parts:
adhikārī caika eva śivatāvāptibhājanam /
tathāpi tāvanmātre ca jāte prakaraṇātmani // [AgMsv_2.281]
quick_english: The qualified person is truly one, the recipient of attaining Śiva-hood; even when the teaching appears only in limited sectional form, that single qualification and attainment remain.

tokens.grounds: past participle from jan; locative singular
